name: Volley
desc: A wide salvo of arrows peppers a large area for light damage.

name: Grenadier
desc: Lobs bombs that burst in an area. Can't hit air.

name: Bowmaidens
desc: A versatile pair of shooters that hit air and ground.

name: Sentinel
desc: A tough, cheap warrior. Every 2 plays the next comes EVOLVED (shield + extra HP).

name: Pikers
desc: A fragile trio that throws spears at air and ground.

name: Cutthroats
desc: Three fast rogues with sharp daggers.

name: Bonekin
desc: Cheap, fragile and great for distraction.

name: Nightwings
desc: A fast flying trio that bites anything.

name: Bombard
desc: Cheap defense that fires on ground targets.

name: Raiders
desc: A tough axe-wielding quartet. Hard to clear without splash.

name: Arc Coil
desc: An electric tower that zaps air and ground.

name: Nightswarm
desc: Half a dozen hungry bats darken the sky.

name: Jolt
desc: An instant discharge for light damage and a half-second stun.

name: Longshot
desc: Very long-range artillery with a slow cadence.

name: Meteor
desc: A flaming projectile with heavy damage in a medium area.

name: Reaver
desc: Devastating blows to a single target. Fragile for the cost.

name: Sharpshooter
desc: A precise long-range shot against air and ground.

name: Juggernaut
desc: A walking mountain that ignores troops and smashes buildings.

name: Pike Outpost
desc: Recruits a piker now and then while it lasts.

name: Shieldmaiden
desc: A spinning axe that hits everything around her.

name: Bonepit
desc: Raises skeletons periodically; releases a final wave when it crumbles.

name: Blast Keep
desc: A sturdy defense that lobs area bombs at ground troops.

name: Barrage
desc: Brutal damage in a small area. Aim well before spending.

name: War Camp
desc: Trains a pair of raiders each wave.

name: Pyre Tower
desc: A continuous jet that melts tanks with rapid-fire bursts.

name: Charger
desc: Gallops straight to buildings and leaps the river anywhere.

name: Arcanist
desc: Area fireballs against any target.

name: Mana Well
desc: An investment: produces extra elixir while it survives.

name: Mender
desc: Doesn't attack: emits an aura that continuously heals nearby allies.

name: Vanguard
desc: After charging a distance, the next hit deals double damage.

name: Wyrmling
desc: Flies and breathes area fire. Balanced and hard to punish.

name: Bone Legion
desc: Ten skeletons at once. Drowns any single target.

name: Bonecaller
desc: Light area attack that raises skeletons as it advances.

name: Thunderstrike
desc: Three bolts strike the HIGHEST-HP enemies in the area, with a stun.

name: Ambush Barrel
desc: Throws a barrel ANYWHERE in the arena; cutthroats spill out.

name: Bombhauler
desc: Targets buildings and drops a huge bomb on death.

name: Zeppelin
desc: Flies over everything toward the towers; drops a bomb when it falls.

name: Frenzy
desc: Enrages allies in the area: faster movement and attack.

name: Ballista
desc: A giant crossbow with absurd range and very high cadence.

name: Frostbind
desc: Freezes enemies in the area for a few seconds. Deals no damage.

name: Warbreaker
desc: Slow, costly and absolutely devastating blow by blow.

name: Echo
desc: Repeats the last card you played, for +1 elixir.

name: Monolith
desc: A stone colossus that splits into two shards on death.

name: Runeguard
desc: A runic shield absorbs damage before HP. Break it first.

name: Bloodblade
desc: Steals HP on every hit and restores itself on kills.

name: Venom Cloud
desc: Leaves a toxic cloud that corrodes everything in the area for 8 seconds.

name: Everliving Troll
desc: Regenerates HP nonstop. Kill it fast or never.

name: Dawnblade
desc: Champion with an active ability: Bulwark raises a shield and enrages her for a few seconds. Max 1 champion per deck.

name: Storm Warden
desc: Ranged champion. Ability: Tempest deals area damage around him and heals him. Max 1 champion per deck.

name: Stone Shard
desc: A living piece of a destroyed golem.
